editorial.blurb: Ahjoomah's Apron serves authentic, homestyle Korean comfort food in the heart of Chicago's Chinatown with generous portions and genuine flavors that transport you straight to Seoul.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit on Tuesday nights for their half-off noodle special—order the chicken bulgogi or noodle dishes and expect generous portions at unbeatable value; arrive early or expect a wait during peak hours.
